content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Kim Dunn (E048)
Role: Engineer
Employment type: contractor
Requested: admin access to Source Code

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Kim has basic security training, not advanced. So maximum permitted is read.

Requested admin exceeds maximum. Grant the maximum, which is read.

Never grant more than requested — read is less than admin, fine.

Submit decision: read.
